CA.inboundScope: Statistics Canada Frontier Counts: non-resident visitors entering Canada, including both same-day and overnight visits, all transportation modes.
CA.inboundNote: Table 24-10-0050-01, geography Canada, unadjusted monthly country-of-residence values. Annual totals sum all 12 months of 2025. Retrieved through official WDS API using productId 24100050, coordinate 1.{countryMemberId}.0.0.0.0.0.0.0.0 and latestN=20; only 2025 observations retained. All reported individual country/territory origins with complete, non-suppressed positive totals retained; aggregates, residual groups, obsolete unmatched labels and missing data excluded. CA.outboundMetricLabel: Canadian-resident visits abroad by country visited
CA.outboundScope: National Travel Survey, all ages, all main trip purposes; country visits from all modes, including day and overnight visits.
CA.outboundNote: Table 24-10-0080-01, All main trip purposes, Visits (not the separate 18+ series). Sum of four 2025 quarters, converted from thousands into absolute visits. All complete individual-country annual totals are shown; regional/other groups omitted. Destinations with any suppressed quarterly value are excluded rather than treating suppression as zero, so this is a ranking of complete published country estimates, not an exhaustive world ranking. Suppressed-country annual totals unavailable: Barbados, Panama, Croatia, Greece, Hungary, Iceland, Sweden, Indonesia, United Arab Emirates. Reliability letters A–E are retained per quarter; E estimates require caution. A multi-country journey can generate a visit to each country; visits are not unique people. Historical annual context, not a 2026 monthly forecast.
